alex: Heads up — saw a perf regression on qwen2.5 canary after yesterday's runtime tweak. p50 up ~12% and p95 spikes on multilingual traffic. cc @maria @junaid
perf-bot: [auto-profile] run=perf-2026-09-08-abc123 flamegraph: https://perf.internal/runs/abc123, summary: matmul_generic high, attention_fallback elevated, kv_cache_locking observed
maria: can you paste the flamegraph top functions? suspect kernel fallback to generic matmul for certain seq_len buckets
alex: copied top entries from perf dump:
```
matmul_generic                43.2%\nattention_kernel_fallback     28.1%\nkv_cache_read_lock             9.4%\ncontinuous_batching_overhead   6.6%\nrope_scaling_apply             4.3%\n```
junaid: kv_cache_read_lock stands out — did we change per-shard KV caps or eviction recently?
kevin: yes — earlier this week we enabled dynamic_kv_eviction and lowered per-shard cap from 256MB -> 192MB to avoid OOM in high-concurrency customers
alex: also noticed tokenizer edge cases — some zh+emoji examples tokenizing into ~600 tokens which pushes flow into long-seq kernels. Example input: "我今天很开心👍🏽..." yields seq_len=612 on qwen2.5 tokenizer tests
yael: if batch heuristic picks long-seq path for a few requests, batching mixes short+long and kernel selection flips, causing some requests to hit slower kernels
maria: can you show kernel-selection logs for a couple of requests around the regression window?
alex: pasting trimmed logs:
```
[2026-09-08T14:02:11Z] request_id=rt-01 kernel=matmul_v2 selected (seq_len=48, heads=64, kv_heads=64)
[2026-09-08T14:02:11Z] request_id=rt-02 kernel=matmul_generic selected (seq_len=612, heads=64, kv_heads=64)
[2026-09-08T14:02:12Z] request_id=rt-03 kernel=attention_fallback selected (seq_len=128, heads=64, kv_heads=32) // kv_head mismatch triggered fallback
```
junaid: that third line shows kv_head mismatch. We recently added an optimization for grouped-kv when kv_heads != heads; the fallback path is not using optimized matmul kernel and is ~2-3x slower
kevin: hypothesis: combination of reduced KV cap causing more remote reads + tokenizer producing outlier long seqs + kv_head mismatch => fallback + lock contention => p95 spikes
yael: also there's a subtle interaction between RoPE scaling factor and ALiBi compatibility flags; if rope_scale != 1.0 and ALIBI compatibility layer is on, we do extra per-step adjustments that inflate rope_scaling_apply cost
maria: suggested mitigations: 1) temporarily pin kernel selection to matmul_v2 for qwen2.5 when heads == kv_heads 2) add a small transform to normalize kv_heads to heads in the loader (cheap copy) to avoid fallback in common configs 3) revert dynamic_kv_eviction for canary customers 4) tweak batching heuristic to bin by seq_len ranges so long outliers don't flip kernel for mixed batches
alex: proposed batching_bins = [32, 64, 128, 256, 512] and prefer batching within same bin instead of raw latency-based packing
junaid: will run two experiments: A) kernel_pin + kvcap back to 256MB B) new batching_bins + verbose kernel logs. Each run will be 10% traffic for 2 hours
perf-bot: scheduled experiment perf-abc123-expt1 (A) and perf-abc123-expt2 (B). Start times: expt1=2026-09-08T17:00Z, expt2=2026-09-08T19:30Z. Reports will be auto-published
kevin: small note — if we normalize kv_heads by copying KV for a subset of layers it increases memory ~+3-4% per-shard. We should ensure dedicated capacity customers tolerances
yael: agree, but for short-term canary it's fine. Also adding a tokenizer unit-test catching zh+emoji length >512 to prevent regressions in future commits
maria: also check ALiBi patch — add an integration test mixing rope_scale=0.7 + alibi_compat=true to catch perf/regressions in CI
alex: I'll open PRs: #1 kernel-pin + verbose kernel logging, #2 kv_head-normalize loader, #3 batching-bin-heuristic, #4 tokenizer-edge-case tests
alex: quick command for canary deploy (example):
```
./deploy_canary --service=infer-rt-qwen2.5 --image=canary-20260908-kernelpin --traffic=10 --env KV_CAP_MB=256 --env BATCH_BINS=32,64,128,256,512
```
maria: after expt1 we should compare p50/p95/token-cost and flamegraphs; focus on matmul_generic and kv_lock slices
junaid: kicking off expt1 now on staging to validate logs/metrics, will post results in ~45m
perf-bot: [note] trace links for experiments: expt1-trace=https://traces.internal/trace/111 expt2-trace=https://traces.internal/trace/222
kevin: if expt1 looks good we can backport kernel-pin to dedicated nodes as emergency mitigation while we fix the kv_head code path properly
yael: added TODO to repo: add multi-ling tokenization harness + a small corpus of zh/ja/emoji combos for fuzzing
alex: thanks everyone. action items: @junaid run experiments + paste flamegraphs; @maria add CI tests for ALiBi+rope; @kevin coordinate dedicated rollback if needed; @yael add tokenizer fuzz corpus PR. We'll reconvene after perf reports. :thumbsup:
